description: This file defines classes and functions related to managing Fibre Channel Protocol (FCP) device configurations for different Red Hat Enterprise Linux versions, including data classes and command parsing logic for zfcp commands.

classes.name: FC3_ZFCPData
classes.description: Data class representing FC protocol data for FC3 version.

classes.name: F12_ZFCPData
classes.description: Data class for F12 version, extending FC3_ZFCPData with additional attribute removal.

classes.name: F14_ZFCPData
classes.description: Data class for F14 version, extending F12_ZFCPData.

classes.name: F37_ZFCPData
classes.description: Data class for F37 version, extending F14_ZFCPData.

classes.name: RHEL9_ZFCPData
classes.description: Data class for RHEL9, extending F14_ZFCPData.

classes.name: FC3_ZFCP
classes.description: Command class for managing FC3 zfcp configurations, including parsing and string representation.

classes.name: F12_ZFCP
classes.description: Subclass for F12 version, modifying parser options.

classes.name: F14_ZFCP
classes.description: Subclass for F14 version, modifying parser options.

classes.name: F37_ZFCP
classes.description: Subclass for F37 version, with extended help and validation logic.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes data classes and command classes with version-specific attributes.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and configures argument parser for zfcp command.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command line arguments into data objects, with duplicate checks.

methods.name: dataList
methods.description: Returns the list of zfcp data objects.

methods.name: dataClass
methods.description: Returns the class used for zfcp data objects.

methods.name: deleteRemovedAttrs
methods.description: Removes attributes marked as removed for specific versions.
